description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for testing purposes, including intercepts for API calls, mock data setup, and login helper functions, tailored to the dashboard web application.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up interceptors for various API endpoints to mock server responses for login, user management, report management, and chart data, facilitating frontend testing without a real backend.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates the login process by filling in the login form and submitting it, then waits for login to complete.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Stores a fake JWT token directly into local storage to simulate an authenticated state.
